metadata.title: Noncongruence cusp forms, Veech groups and enumeration
metadata.abstract: We prove the existence of weight 2 modular forms for some Veech groups, whose Fourier coefficients at a cusp determine the counts of numbers of branched Galois covers of punctured elliptic curves. We further prove there exist cusp forms, counting ramified genus $2$ covers, that are not invariant under any congruence subgroup of SL(2,Z). The main results may be viewed as analogs of the construction of an elliptic curve obtained as the quotient of the Jacobian of a classical modular curve, whose point counts modulo primes determine the coefficients of a Hecke eigenform, but where the uniformizing groups may be noncongruence.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: Veech 群的非同余尖点形式
analysis.workSummary: 构造某些 Veech 群的权二模形式，其 cusp Fourier 系数计数穿孔椭圆曲面的分歧 Galois 覆叠，并给出不被任何同余子群保持的亏格二覆叠计数尖点形式。
analysis.breakthrough: 把经典模曲线的算术计数图景延伸到部分非同余一致化群。
analysis.limitations: 构造针对特定 Veech 群及覆叠计数，不构成所有非同余模形式的分类。
